title: BrowserActionReceipt
description: One evidence record for a single driver-neutral browser command (browser_control.BrowserAdapter, minted by the harness TabControlAPI). The load-bearing invariant: 'the important thing is not the driver, it is that every action produces an evidence record.' READ-ONLY by default: an act command (click/fill/submit) is refused (executed=false, verifier_result=refused_read_only) unless side effects are enabled, and any side_effect_level >= 'write' emits requires_confirmation=true and is never auto-executed. Secrets are redacted before the receipt is written (filled values, tokens). Digests + bounded input only; no raw bodies. candidate; serves_truth=false. The side_effect_level enum is the single source scripts.primitive_browser_control_harness.SIDE_EFFECT_LEVELS; browser_control/self_test.py fails if the two drift.

schema_version.description: version lives in metadata, never in an id or name

command_id.description: canonical_id('bcmd', session_id, action, tick) — content-addressed, not a raw counter

backend.description: the driver that executed the command (fake/http_scrape/cdp/playwright/...)

action.description: the command name (navigate, tab_snapshot, tab_click_ref, tab_fill_ref, focus_tab, capture_screenshot, capture_network, download_artifacts, verify_text, verify_url, build_tab_graph, ...)

input.description: bounded, secret-redacted command input (never raw form values or secrets)

before_state_hash.description: sha256:... of the tab state before the command (null if not applicable)

after_state_hash.description: sha256:... of the tab state after the command

side_effect_level.description: the side-effect calculus ladder; >= 'write' requires human confirmation even when side effects are permitted

requires_confirmation.description: true when a human must confirm before the side effect executes

executed.description: whether the command actually ran (false for refused/pending-confirmation acts)

verifier_result.description: captured | empty | passed | failed | ok | focused | closed | protected_last_tab | listed | built | refused_read_only | gated_executed | gated_pending_confirmation | gated_confirmed_execute

artifact_refs.description: handles/digests produced (screenshot_hash, spec urls, download urls, opened tab ids) — never raw bytes
